**补充作业(主要用于复习)：**

一、跟着飞书笔记完成当天所学知识，至少练习一遍，加油.

@通过以下两个表完成后续作业:

1.class表

##创建表

CREATE TABLE class(

    id int unsigned auto_increment primary key,

    name varchar(30) not null,

    ctime int unsigned not null

);

##插入测试数据

INSERT INTO class(id, name, ctime) VALUES

(1, 'class1', unix_timestamp()),

(2, 'class2', unix_timestamp()),

(3, 'class3', unix_timestamp());

![](data:image/png;base64,)

2.user表

##创建表

CREATE TABLE user(

    id int unsigned auto_increment primary key,

    username varchar(50) not null,

    age tinyint unsigned not null,

    class_id int unsigned not null

) ;

##插入测试数据

INSERT INTO user(id, username, age, class_id) VALUES

(1, 'user1', 19, 1),

(2, 'user2', 19, 1),

(3, 'user3', 19, 1),

(4, 'user4', 19, 1),

(5, 'user5', 19, 2),

(6, 'user6', 19, 3),

(7, 'user7', 19, 2),

(8, 'user8', 19, 1),

(9, 'user9', 19, 2),

(10, 'user10', 19, 3);
